climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Loire Valley white wine, usually dry, made from Chenin Blanc on three schist hills on the right bank in Anjou-Saumur. It covers about 740 acres in three communes, with two enclave appellations inside it.
